title: Prince Yūsuf ibn Saʿd leaves the appeasing of the estates, which he had done since the Jamāʿa of 817, and turns to drawing settlers to Ishbīliya
Jadīla bint Saʿd leaves the stabilising of the realm and turns to developing Ishbīliya
Tamaraceite on Gran Canaria becomes a settlement of the crown, the second in the Canaries: 8,500 Guanche islanders of their own faith

The Secret of the Naft. Ethiopia offers the Emperor a sum of money for the empire's naft, its fire weapons. To sell is to let them be used against al-Andalus one day; the court answers that it will never backfire

data.text: Ethiopia has offered us a sum of money if we are to sell them some of our weaponry, specifically the nafts. We can accept, but that will allow them to potentially use them against us (the game's text)
data.choice: It will never backfire (the option whose tooltip is open; the other was 'They will not have our weapons!')

effects.Ethiopia: unlocks the Naft Throwers unit type
effects.al-Andalus: receives 419.55 gold from Ethiopia, 200% of yearly income

title: The Ṭāʾifa of Burtuqāl proclaims itself the Kingdom of Portugal. Its lord Aḥmad ibn Ismāʿīl, the Emperor's cousin, takes the crown of the old kings and remains the Emperor's ṭāʾifa; the new kingdom's state faith is Catholic, the faith of its people, though its king is a Muslim

data.ruler: Aḥmad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Yūsuf, Sunni
